task: Recover CHAT utterance boundaries from target-child transcript paragraphs; preserve all words
private_cohort_role: Final evaluation only. No training, adaptation, threshold/epoch/rule/model/routing selection on the 10 participants.
historical_caveat: The private cohort and public test benchmark were examined in prior rounds; they cannot be represented as pristine independent tests.
decoding: Independent class argmax or learned CRF maximum-score sequence; no tuned probability cutoff, length cap or pause threshold
primary_selection: Highest full-paragraph TalkBank validation micro boundary F1; exact ties prefer fewer parameters, then lexical candidate name

training.crop_selection: Seeded word positions independent of gold labels; mask crop final gap; recompute rules from cropped input
training.sequence_adaptation: Initialize from training/validation-selected MiniLM; max 3 epochs; encoder 1e-5, head 3e-5, CRF 3e-3
training.averaging: Additionally score equal parameter average of the final 3 trained epochs, if available; validation only

final_evaluation: Freeze one candidate and all deployment choices before opening public test/private cohort. Evaluate once in paragraph-per-recording mode; speaker-turn transfer is separately reported, never used for changes.
metric_policy: Existing surface eligibility/filler policy and TAALED remain unchanged; annotation-dependent metrics remain missing without evidence

incumbent_argmax.note: Existing checkpoint, evaluated without its old validation-calibrated cutoff

reference_baseline.name: CHATUtterance checkpoint, common word-gap adapter
reference_baseline.role: Frozen external reference only; not used for candidate selection or adaptation
reference_baseline.training_provenance: Official pinned model card says MICASE, distinct from OCSC and NYU-Emerson
reference_baseline.adapter: First subtoken of each complete word; six-class argmax labels 2/3/4 are utterance ends. Fixed 512-subtoken windows, stride 256, center-weighted six-class logits. Preserve every source word; no Punkt, capitalization, or hanging-word postfilter. This evaluates the checkpoint, not the complete published Batchalign pipeline.

implementation_notes: The proposed six-layer Microsoft MiniLM identifier was unavailable. The official available 12-layer/384-dimensional checkpoint was verified and pinned before protocol registration.
CRF exhaustive-path fixture initially had a tied optimal path; the fixture was made non-tied. The decoder and likelihood passed exhaustive-score and padding checks before CRF training.

execution_adjustments.reason: Local MPS GPU became available when run outside the filesystem sandbox; CPU attempt interrupted for compute efficiency, not based on test data
execution_adjustments.restart: Same pretrained initialization, seed, examples, optimizer settings and epoch limit; local MPS backend
execution_adjustments.determinism: Fixed RNG seed; MPS deterministic algorithms requested with warnings for unsupported operations

deployment.workbook_default: Established rules, unchanged regardless of private results
